headline: Brazil Central Bank Holds Selic Rate at 13.75%
summary: Brazil's Monetary Policy Committee (Copom) decided to maintain the Selic interest rate at 13.75% per year, meeting market expectations.
why: The Selic rate is the primary tool for managing inflation in Brazil. Decisions by the central bank directly influence borrowing costs, currency valuation, and the attractiveness of Brazilian fixed-income assets.
why_moved: The decision to pause rate cuts impacts the yield curve and the relative attractiveness of the Brazilian Real compared to foreign currencies.
